founders.name: Aswin Andrison
founders.bio: Aswin co-founded TazkerAI on the back of Lumina (YC W22), an autonomous AI+human-powered workflow automation for the physical industry. Prior to that, he co-founded STOQO, a pioneer fresh-produce supplier for 40,000 restaurants with 1,500-strong workforce and USD 13M raised from top investors (Accel, Monk's Hill and AlphaJWC, etc). Before startups, Aswin consulted at McKinsey, IBM and Honeywell. He graduated computer science / chemical eng. from UNSW and MBA from London Business School and MIT.
